extras: Desktop only; no network requests, telemetry, or external service accounts required.
intentEvidence: SVG Zoom Viewer is an Obsidian desktop plugin that opens SVG and common image embeds in a dedicated zoomable view.
problem: Users lack a simple way to view embedded images or SVGs in a dedicated, zoomable, and interactive view within Obsidian.
summary: SVG Zoom Viewer is a desktop plugin that allows users to double-click embedded images or SVGs to open them in a dedicated, zoomable view.
